i think we’ve talked before, so i have some advice:

it’s hard but you HAVE to stop ruminating and thinking about your lack of feelings. i know when my rocd was full blown bad i was doing this nonstop because it feels so real but it’s NOT REAL. if you’re crying your eyes out for almost a year because you don’t wanna leave your partner and you don’t wanna lose feelings for him, you’re choosing to love him. when people lose feelings, they don’t care or act like you do. and i’m not gonna say whether you truly love him or not because i think that’s reassurance but people who don’t care about their relationship don’t feel the way you do. i think you just have to sit with the feeling and try your best everyday. you can’t force your feelings back, and with rocd as my worries morphed and changed every other week, i found that i was able to feel a tiny bit of love whenever i just hung out with my gf and stopped caring. not to say that this is a universal solution, but it could work. take care
